newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CONSTRUCTION LOBBY SEES 10 PCT 1997 GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CONSTRUCTION LOBBY SEES 10 PCT 1997 GROWTH.

text.p: The Finnish construction industry federation (RTK) said in a cyclical forecast on Thursday that it expected the volume of construction in Finland to increase by 10 percent this year.
"RTK is expecting that the growth this year in construction volume will be 10 percent," it said in a statement.
Housing construction starts would increase to 30,000 this year and be 30,000 again in 1998 from last year's 24,000, RTK said.
Construction investment relative to GDP would increase in the next few years to 10-11 percent, or even higher, from nine percent currently.
"This will mean that current construction output will grow by about 25 percent," RTK said.

Employment in the construction sector would increase this year by 10 percent, the federation said. In 1996, the construction industry employed 117,000 people, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
